title: Exterior Painting in Dunnellon, FL | Wood, Stucco, Porches
description: Exterior painting in Dunnellon, FL for Cracker-style wood homes and stucco houses near the rivers. Mildew treatment, rot repair, and a written warranty.
heroIntro: Year-round humidity and summer storms are hard on any exterior. We prep and coat Dunnellon homes so the paint keeps water out of wood siding, porches, and stucco for the long haul.

questions: What is the best time of year to paint an exterior in Dunnellon?
How do you paint porch floors and rails on an older home?
What coating works best on stucco with hairline cracks?

body: Dunnellon properties live with humidity all year, not just in summer. Walls near the water or under heavy shade stay damp, and mildew settles in quickly. Open south and west walls take relentless UV. Exterior painting in Dunnellon, FL has to handle moisture and sun on the same house, so our estimate notes conditions elevation by elevation. Learn more about how we work in Dunnellon.

sections.h2: Wood siding and porches on older homes
body: The historic Florida Cracker homes in Historic Downtown are wood-framed with board siding and generous porches. Those porches are where exteriors fail first: floorboards hold water, rail caps crack, and post bases rot where they meet the deck. We replace soft wood, scrape and sand to a sound surface, prime bare wood, and coat with materials suited to each part: 100% acrylic on siding and trim, and waterborne urethane enamel on railings and doors.
Old wood windows deserve care too. Cracked glazing and paint around sashes let water in fast; our article on cracked paint on window frames explains why it matters.

sections.h2: Stucco and block in the newer neighborhoods
body: Homes in Rainbow Lake Estates, Rolling Hills, and parts of Rio Vista lean toward stucco and block. Hairline cracks are common, and paint that cannot stretch will split along them. We repair cracks and apply an elastomeric coating where the stucco shows movement. Block walls get a high-build masonry system that fills texture.

Shaded lots in Rainbow Springs bring their own challenge: the north and east walls may look fine from the street but carry a film of mildew that has to be killed, not just rinsed, before primer will bond. Painting over living growth is one of the most common reasons a Florida repaint fails early, so we treat it as a separate prep step on the estimate.

bullets: Soft wash with mildew treatment, then full dry time
Moisture readings on suspect wood; rot and fascia replacement
Re-caulk joints and spot-prime bare areas
Cover windows, light fixtures, and landscaping
Two full coats, sprayed areas back-brushed or back-rolled

body: October through May is the prime season. Summer jobs start early and watch dew point and radar. A full exterior typically takes three to seven working days, plus washing and drying. Exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years plus the manufacturer warranty. Faded paint in Marion County sun is common; see restoring sun-damaged paint. Most jobs begin with a soft wash in Dunnellon, and our main exterior painting page has more detail.

faqs.q: When should I paint my Dunnellon home's exterior?
faqs.a: October through May is ideal. Summer work is possible with early starts and careful attention to dew point and storms.

faqs.q: Do you repair porches before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Rotted floorboards, rail sections, and trim are replaced during prep, and the work is itemized on the estimate.

faqs.q: What warranty do exterior jobs carry?
faqs.a: Our own written workmanship warranty runs up to 10 years on exterior work, and the paint maker's warranty applies separately.
